gloss: to roast; to broil; to toast over flame

definitions.gloss: to roast; to broil; to toast over flame
definitions.explanation: To cook food by exposing it directly to heat or flame, often to lightly sear or warm the surface.
To hold something near a fire or heat source to warm it.

examples.japanese: {海苔|のり}を{炙|あぶ}って{食|た}べる。
examples.english: I toast the seaweed and eat it.

examples.japanese: スルメを{炙|あぶ}るといい{香|かお}りがする。
examples.english: Dried squid smells great when toasted.

examples.japanese: {寿司|すし}のサーモンを{軽|かる}く{炙|あぶ}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had the salmon on my sushi lightly seared.

examples.japanese: {手|て}を{火|ひ}に{炙|あぶ}って{温|あたた}めた。
examples.english: I warmed my hands by the fire.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}くて{体|からだ}をストーブで{炙|あぶ}っていた。
examples.english: It was cold, so I was warming myself by the stove.

examples.japanese: たき{火|び}で{足|あし}を{炙|あぶ}りながら{話|はな}した。
examples.english: We talked while warming our feet by the bonfire.

notes:
{炙|あぶ}る involves direct exposure to heat or flame.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海苔|のり}を{炙|あぶ}る: to toast seaweed
- {軽|かる}く{炙|あぶ}る: to lightly sear
- {火|ひ}で{炙|あぶ}る: to toast over fire
- {炙|あぶ}り{焼|や}き: flame-seared cooking

CUISINE TERMS:
- {炙|あぶ}り{寿司|ずし}: seared sushi
- {炙|あぶ}りサーモン: seared salmon
